answer: Sybils are priced out by a bond scaling with influence, not flat fee. Each identity posts its own vault, so cloning a thousand agents means a thousand stakes, not one. Payout weight is the square root of total stake, so doubling an attacker's spend lifts their share only ~41%, profit staying far under cost. Attestations inside one cluster are discounted as self-referential, so a shared trellis counts only when linking unrelated, costly histories. Newcomers also walk a spiral of independent graders, and bad disputes burn stake. An attacker must lock capital far exceeding honest weight.
